text:
jessica_sales: Orion Bank POC kickoff — they want SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning + RBAC via group mapping, plus domain-proofing (only verified org domains). Pricing question: hosted vs dedicated delta and ops/onboarding cost. Legal wants our security questionnaire answered. Can SEs confirm scope and blockers this week?

ronnie_se: I can own SAML/SCIM config + feasibility. Which IdP/version are they on?@jessica_sales

jessica_sales: They're on Okta (org uses on-prem AD -> Okta sync). Expect ~18k users. SCIM needs delta sync + initial bulk import.

dinesh_eng: Okta + 18k users is fine. Couple quick Qs: do they expect near-real-time SCIM (delta push) or nightly batch? RBAC — group->role mapping or attribute-based claims?

jessica_sales: They said near-real-time delta is preferred. Group->role mapping for now (they already manage groups in Okta). Also want domain lock: only allow provisioning from verified domains, and block tenant creation for unverified email domains. They asked about wildcard subdomains handling too.

lina_security: For domain proofing we support DNS TXT and MX verification; email challenge is fallback. Recommend DNS TXT for enterprise. Also need to confirm KMS: do they require customer-managed keys (CMK) / HSM? If yes, we'll need SOC docs + onboarding.

grant_pm: Pricing note: for 18k users with real-time SCIM + SAML auth bursts, we should propose Dedicated (reserved capacity) for predictable SLOs. SEs — can you estimate QPS for auth flows + SCIM deltas so I can price reserved GPU pools + onboarding hours? Also include security review cost and optional KMS integration.

ronnie_se: Quick back-of-envelope: initial SCIM bulk import could produce ~5k reqs/min for a short window; steady-state delta ~500-1k events/min depending on churn. SAML logins: low steady qps but peaks during morning rollout — estimate 200-350 rps peak per region. Hosted could handle small POC but no SLA. Dedicated recommended for enterprise SLAs. I'll draft numbers.

jessica_sales: Can we get the SAML metadata snippet (ACS URL / EntityID) I should share with their IdP team?

dinesh_eng: Share this suggested SAML metadata (ACS + EntityID) — feel free to paste to Okta:

```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.example.com/saml/orion">
  <SPSSODescriptor AuthnRequestsSigned="false" WantAssertionsSigned="true">
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs/orion"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

dinesh_eng: For group->role mapping, we'll accept Okta group names mapped to role identifiers in our RBAC config. Example mapping: `Okta:Engineering -> role:engineer_readwrite` — we can provide a CSV mapping template.

lina_security: For the security questionnaire: I'll upload our completed vendor security pack and a short answers doc for SAML/SCIM/KMS. Ask them to fill their vendor questionnaire first; we can do a joint call for clarifications. Also: we will need their penetration test cadence and data classification for POC data.

idp-bot: deploy-bot: created workspace `orion-bank-poc` and set default log retention to 90d.

jessica_sales: Action items:
- @ronnie_se: draft SAML/SCIM throughput estimates + temp rate bump recommendations by EOD Wed.
- @lina_security: prep security answers + outline KMS options (CMK vs managed) and docs needed.
- @dinesh_eng: confirm RBAC mapping flow, provide CSV template for group->role mapping, and SCIM bulk import plan.
I'll sync with customer and share a preliminary pricing deck (hosted vs dedicated + onboarding) once estimates are in.

ronnie_se: One more: SCIM rate limits — POC customers often hit limits. We can propose a temporary higher quota (e.g., 4k requests/min) for the initial sync window, then tune down to steady-state.

jessica_sales: Perfect. Also note: they want domain verification automated for subdomains (e.g., *.orionbank.com). We'll need legal sign-off for wildcard verification.

lina_security: Wildcard domain proofing increases risk surface; require registrar verification + documented ownership. I'll flag to legal.

jessica_sales: Great — thanks all :thumbsup: I'll coordinate a 30m sync with their IdP engineer tomorrow at 10am PT.

ronnie_se: Sounds good. I'll bring the throughput slides and sample config.

dinesh_eng: I'll prepare the CSV mapping template and SCIM bulk script snippet.

jessica_sales: End of thread — tracking in the POC workspace.
